description: Full-day departure schedule for a stop. Lists every departure by route and direction for the specified date (defaults to today). Optionally filter departure rows by routeId and a half-open Unix-millisecond interval; selection includes counts before and after filtering. Without selectors, returns the complete mapped schedule with no default cap. For live predictions, use onebusaway_get_arrivals instead.

anyOf.description: A real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form (e.g. "2026-05-23").

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2026-05-23"). Must be a real calendar date. Omit or leave blank for today in the agency's timezone.

departureBeforeMs.description: Exclusive departure upper bound in Unix milliseconds; must exceed departureFromMs when both are supplied.

departureFromMs.description: Inclusive departure lower bound in Unix milliseconds.

routeId.description: Exact route ID, combined with departure bounds; omit or leave blank for all routes.

stopId.description: Agency-prefixed stop ID (e.g. "1_75403"). Use onebusaway_find_stops or onebusaway_search_stops to discover IDs.

name: onebusaway_get_schedule_for_stop

date.description: Date parameter used for the schedule request, if specified.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `stop_not_found`: Stop ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no routes were found — e.g. no service on weekends or holiday schedule in effect.

routeCount.description: Number of routes with departures from this stop on this date.

routes.description: All routes with departures from this stop on this date.

items.description: A route with its scheduled departures from this stop.

directions.description: Service directions for this route at this stop.

items.description: A service direction at this stop.

scheduledDepartureTime.description: Scheduled departure time as Unix milliseconds.

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.

routeId.description: Route ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_route or onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route calls.

selection.description: Applied selectors and departure counts before and after local selection; absent without selectors.

departureBeforeMs.description: Exclusive departure upper bound in Unix milliseconds; must exceed departureFromMs when both are supplied.

departureFromMs.description: Inclusive departure lower bound in Unix milliseconds.

routeId.description: Exact route ID, combined with departure bounds; omit or leave blank for all routes.

serviceDateMs.description: Unchanged upstream schedule-date marker in Unix milliseconds: query time when date is omitted or blank, instance-local midnight for an explicit date.

timezone.description: Validated timezone of the queried stop agency, or UTC when unavailable or invalid.

title: Get Stop Schedule
